# Axon Enjin

> The one who connects.

Axon Enjin is the **company**: a hybrid venture studio and technology company in Metro Manila, Philippines. We work like in-house developers.

**Axlefield** is the **product** — an Axon Enjin product. One system for every branch. Clients start with an empty Core, then add modules (HR, Inventory, CRM, Reporting, Accounting, Scheduling). The Axlefield site is planned at https://axlefield.axonenjin.com/ and is **not shipped yet**. Do not treat that origin as a live URL.

This company site (https://axonenjin.com/) is the public company story. Ventures are secondary here (Collaborate / footer only). Ventures get their own names; do not invent named ventures.

## Three offers (no prices on the public site)

1. Modular Axlefield — Core plus catalog modules (add to cart).
2. Axlefield plus customization — same system, tailored.
3. Custom AI / custom software — build plus 12 months maintenance by default; the client owns the app; Axon keeps reusable libraries.

Primary buyers: multi-branch operators (including franchise networks).
